# Requirements Quality Review Checklist: Migrating Existing Spec to Spec Kit Lifecycle

**Purpose**: Peer-review (PR) validation of the quality of spec.md requirements — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, migration/rollback coverage, constitution alignment and non-functional coverage — before planning
**Created**: 2026-10-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It was generated from spec.md and the constitution only (plan.md does not exist yet).
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact deliverables of the migration (which of `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md` and which baseline documents are covered) enumerated as requirements rather than only described in the Overview? [Completeness, Spec §Overview]
- [ ] CHK002 Is every baseline requirement ID referenced in FR-001..FR-008 (e.g. `FR-ING-01..08`, `FR-TUT-01..12`) traceable to the baseline `spec/SPEC.md`, with no baseline IDs left unmapped? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the baseline acceptance criteria (AC-01 through AC-38) mapped to the acceptance scenarios in this spec? [Gap, Traceability]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the quiz hint feature's grounding, beyond the single "Need a hint?" scenario? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the "live curriculum sync trigger" in the Settings Drawer covered by acceptance scenarios? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "full parity" between existing features and Spec Kit artifacts defined with an objective criterion? [Ambiguity, Spec §Overview]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "fail gracefully with descriptive error codes" specified with the error codes or error categories expected? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "friendly message" for empty or missing content specified with required content or wording? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 1 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "clear status error" for tutor unreachable or timeout defined (what is shown, and the timeout threshold)? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 2 Scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "standard broadband" and "standard AI provider endpoints" quantified for SC-001 and SC-003? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-001, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "rejected or returned with standard ungrounded fallbacks" for prompt injection resolved to a single required behavior? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Does the "100% of tutor responses contain a citation or fallback" requirement stay consistent with the streaming-interruption requirement, where partial responses are shown? [Conflict, Spec §SC-002, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the spec's single-lesson-scope tutor requirement consistent with the constitution's requirement that citations use the `[<lesson title> § <heading>]` format? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the contrast requirements in User Story 4 Scenario 1, FR-008 and SC-005 consistent (the "all UI elements" scope in SC-005 against the narrower theme scope elsewhere)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the "Settings Drawer" parameters in User Story 4 (API key, endpoint, temperature) match FR-007 (model selection, token budget)? [Conflict, Spec §User Story 4, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Does FR-005's "exclusively in `localStorage`" remain consistent with User Story 4's storage of API key settings, given the key is sensitive? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, User Story 4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can "0% ungrounded hallucinations" (SC-002) be objectively measured, and is the measurement method defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the thresholds in SC-006 ("15+" backend tests, "24+" E2E tests) consistent with the constitution's quality gates and with a stated source of truth for the counts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Constitution §Quality Gates]
- [ ] CHK019 Does every functional requirement (FR-001..FR-008) have at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion that can verify it? [Coverage, Spec §Requirements]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the success measure for "full parity" with the baseline spec defined (e.g. 100% of baseline requirement IDs mapped)? [Gap, Measurability]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are rollback requirements defined for the case where migration of the baseline spec fails partway or leaves the artifacts inconsistent with `spec/SPEC.md`? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the ingestion failure case of "no partially written files" (atomicity or cleanup), and for recovery after a failed sync? [Clarity, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the divergence case where the Spec Kit artifacts and baseline `spec/*` files drift apart after migration (single source of truth)? [Gap, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK024 Are retry requirements specified for the streaming-interruption case (retry limits, preservation of the partial answer, input state)? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for concurrent or repeated tutor requests and for rate limiting? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for learners with no stored progress, and for corrupted or unavailable `localStorage`? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Are security requirements for the API key entered in the Settings Drawer (storage, transmission, exposure) specified? [Gap, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the sanitization requirements (FR-004) specific about disallowed elements, attributes and URL schemes, consistent with the constitution's restrictive-schema requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the accessibility requirements limited to contrast, or are keyboard navigation, focus management and 44×44px touch-target requirements from the constitution also captured? [Gap, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK030 Are performance requirements specified for network conditions beyond the single "standard broadband" case, and for tutor and quiz responsiveness? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001, SC-003]

## Constitution Alignment & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK031 Does the spec state the constitution's technology constraints (DC-01..DC-11) as requirements or explicit exclusions, so the planning phase has them as inputs? [Gap, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the SSE write-deadline safety requirement (`FR-TUT-11`) reflected in the spec's tutor streaming requirements? [Gap, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the dependency on the pinned upstream commit SHA documented, including the behavior when the upstream is unavailable (assumed accessible in Assumptions)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the assumption that the AI provider is OpenAI-compatible validated, and is the behavior for non-compatible providers specified? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
